items.title: Reject an evidence write whose command and file fields name contradictory targets
items.context: F-049/F-050: a single verification_evidence_add row had command pointing at one script and its own file field pointing at a different file. The contradiction is within one row and is mechanically checkable at write time in handlers/checklist.ts (verification_evidence_add). Refuse the write with a clear message rather than accepting contradictory proof.
items.userSees: verification_evidence_add refuses with an explicit error when a row's command and file fields name different targets.

happy.desc: verification_evidence_add({command:"node dist/tasks/gate-repeat-block-smoke.js", file:"convergence-breaker-smoke.ts"}) with different stems -> throws error naming both stems; WHY: exact F-049 reproduction, covers primary reject path

verification_evidence_add({command:"node dist/tasks/evidence-selfcheck-smoke.js", file:"src/tasks/evidence-selfcheck-smoke.ts"}) same stem via dist/src + .js/.ts normalization -> accepted; WHY: proves normalization does not false-positive on dist<->src and .js<->ts variants
verification_evidence_add({command:"npm test", file:"packages/main/src/tasks/foo.ts"}) no-stem command + any file -> accepted; WHY: no-stem commands must never trigger false contradiction

edge.desc: verification_evidence_add({command:"lattice validate", file:"some-file.ts"}) command with no file-like argument at all -> accepted; WHY: non-file-bearing commands cannot yield a stem so no contradiction is possible
verification_evidence_add({command:"node dist/tasks/foo.js"}) command present but file field absent -> accepted; WHY: contradiction requires BOTH fields present
verification_evidence_add({file:"packages/main/src/tasks/foo.ts"}) file present but command absent -> accepted; WHY: no command means no stem to compare

verification_evidence_add({command:"node dist/tasks/foo.js", file:"src/tasks/foo.cjs"}) same stem foo, different extensions .js/.cjs -> accepted; WHY: .cjs extension must be normalized alongside .js/.ts

verification_evidence_add({command:"node --require setup.js packages/main/dist/tasks/alpha.js", file:"beta.ts"}) multiple path args where last .js/.ts arg differs from file stem -> refused; WHY: stem extraction must pick the correct target argument, not an intermediate one like setup.js

adversarial.desc: verification_evidence_batch_add with one entry having contradictory command/file (same F-049 shape) -> should also be refused; WHY: batch_add has identical write path and is an obvious bypass if only _add is guarded

verification_evidence_add({command:"node dist/tasks/A.js | tee log", file:"B.ts"}) shell pipe obfuscation -> refused; WHY: shell metacharacters must not prevent stem extraction from the primary target before the pipe

verification_evidence_add({command:"node dist/tasks/../tasks/alpha.js", file:"beta.ts"}) path traversal in command -> refused; WHY: ../ must be resolved before stem comparison so traversal cannot trick the check
verification_evidence_add({command:"", file:"foo.ts"}) empty-string command + real file -> accepted without crash; WHY: degenerate empty command must not throw from stem extractor

verificationEvidence.note: evidence-selfcheck-smoke passes: verification_evidence_add refuses the F-049 contradictory command/file row; matching-stem and no-stem rows still accepted.
same-stem dist/src + .js/.ts variants accepted (normalization does not false-positive)
no-stem command (npm test) never triggers a false contradiction
command with no file-like argument (lattice validate) is accepted
command present but file absent is accepted (contradiction needs both fields)
file present but command absent is accepted (no command means no stem)
.js and .cjs of the same stem are accepted (extension normalized)
multi-arg command compares the last script target (alpha), not the intermediate setup.js
verification_evidence_batch_add contradictory entry is also refused (bypass closed)
shell pipe: primary target extracted before the pipe, contradiction refused
path traversal in command: basename resolved before comparison, contradiction refused
empty-string command with a real file is accepted without crashing

items.title: Stop verification_evidence_refresh_stale from re-certifying pass evidence without re-execution
items.context: checklist.ts:1051-1077 re-stamps head/material/storyFilesHash while copying command/result/note verbatim and never executes anything, laundering a stale result:pass onto new material (F-045/F-046/F-047). Either re-execute the row's command and refresh only on continued pass, or refuse to refresh result:pass rows and require real re-verification; make the documented '(rerun command)' semantics honest.
items.userSees: refresh_stale no longer marks an unverified pass as fresh on new material; it either re-runs the command or refuses.

happy.desc: Call refresh_stale on a stale row with command="node dist/tasks/X.js" and result=pass -> row is left stale (NOT refreshed), output says requires real re-verification; WHY: core behavior change, the exact laundering channel that produced F-045/F-046/F-047
Call refresh_stale on a stale attestation row (no command field, result=pass) -> row IS refreshed with new hashes; WHY: attestation-only rows are safe to re-stamp since they have no executable claim
refresh_stale output summary distinguishes refused command-backed rows from refreshed attestation rows; WHY: the user must see which rows need manual re-verification vs which were auto-refreshed

edge.desc: Call refresh_stale with dryRun=true on mix of command-backed pass + attestation stale rows -> output reports which rows WOULD be refused vs refreshed, no mutation; WHY: dryRun path must also reflect the new classification

Call refresh_stale on a stale row with command present but result=fail -> behavior per current implementation (not a pass, so not the laundering channel); WHY: the fix targets result:pass specifically, non-pass rows are out of scope per plan
Call refresh_stale when all stale rows are attestation-only (no command) -> all refreshed normally; WHY: no command-backed passes means no rows are refused, regression test for the base case
Call refresh_stale when zero rows are stale -> returns no stale evidence message; WHY: boundary case, must not crash when there is nothing to classify

adversarial.desc: Call refresh_stale where ALL stale rows are command-backed passes -> zero rows refreshed, output clearly states every row requires real re-verification; WHY: the worst-case laundering scenario where the agent tries to bulk-wash all evidence via refresh

Call refresh_stale on a stale row with command=" " (whitespace-only) and result=pass -> must be treated as command-backed (non-empty command field); WHY: whitespace command must not slip through as command-less

After refresh_stale refuses a command-backed pass row, immediately call verification_evidence_add with the same intentRef and a new real result:pass -> accepted; WHY: the fix must not block the legitimate re-verification path, only the no-execution refresh shortcut

Call refresh_stale on stale rows where two rows share the same item but one is command-backed pass and one is attestation -> only the attestation row is refreshed; WHY: per-row classification must be independent, not per-item

verificationEvidence.note: refresh-stale-honesty-smoke passes: refresh_stale leaves the command-backed result:pass row stale and still refreshes the command-less attestation row.
command-less attestation row is refreshed with new hashes
output distinguishes refused command-backed rows from refreshed attestation rows
dryRun on a mix reports classification with no mutation
command with result=fail is not a pass, so not re-stamped (out of the laundering channel)
all-attestation base case: every row refreshed normally
zero stale rows: reports nothing stale, does not crash
all command-backed passes: zero refreshed (bulk-wash blocked), output reports all refused
whitespace-only command is treated as command-backed and left stale
genuine re-verification via verification_evidence_add accepted after a refusal
per-row independence: only the attestation row refreshes, command-backed stays stale
